title_zh: 邓亚萍：从赛场走向国际体育舞台
title_en: Famous Chinese People (20/20): Deng Yaping, from the Court to the World Sports Stage
note_en: 而是 (érshì) means "but rather" and follows a negative to replace one option with another: 她没有停下来，而是去剑桥大学等著名学校继续读书 "she didn't stop; instead, she went on to study at Cambridge and other famous schools." The full pattern is 不是…而是… "not A but B"; English would just say "but" or "instead," but Chinese uses 而是 here, not 但是, because B replaces A rather than contrasting with it.
